areas.summary_vi: Không tìm thấy nguồn nào nêu tên giống lúa ở Vĩnh Châu. Để trống giống.

sources.title: Soc Trang increasingly switches to speciality rice varieties
sources.quote: (province-wide) ST24, ST25, Tai Nguyen, RVT, Dai Thom 8 about 92% of output
sources.note: Fetched. Province-wide only; the page does not mention Vinh Chau.

areas.summary_en: District socio-economic reports (Jan and Q1 2025) list Đài Thơm 8, RVT, ST24, ST25 as common varieties. The government site could not be fetched, so this rests on a search snippet. The '40 ha ST25 with local grower groups' claim was NOT found for Tran De: the matching article is Hòa Bình commune, Cà Mau (27 Mar 2026), 40 ha, 20 households.
areas.summary_vi: Báo cáo KT-XH huyện (tháng 1 và quý I/2025) nêu Đài thơm 8, RVT, ST24, ST25 là giống phổ biến. Không truy cập được trang gốc nên chỉ dựa vào đoạn trích tìm kiếm. Thông tin '40 ha ST25' KHÔNG thuộc Trần Đề: bài khớp là xã Hòa Bình, Cà Mau (27/3/2026).

sources.title: BC KTXH tháng 01 năm 2025 (UBND huyện Trần Đề)
sources.quote: Loại giống phổ biến: Đài thơm 8, RVT, ST24, ST25, ĐS1
sources.note: Quote appears in a web search result snippet; the host did not resolve from our tools (ENOTFOUND), so the page was not opened. Same report family lists prices ST25 about 8,200-8,500 d/kg, Đài thơm 8 about 6,500-6,600 d/kg (snippet only).

sources.title: BC KTXH quý 1 năm 2025 (UBND huyện Trần Đề)
sources.quote: lúa thơm, lúa đặc sản chiếm 90,64% diện tích
sources.note: Snippet only, not fetched. Reported 22,290 ha, 6.61 t/ha.

sources.title: Mô hình ST25 HTX Green Farm, Hòa Bình (40 ha, 20 hộ)
sources.quote: năng suất lúa vẫn đạt 7,7 tấn/ha
sources.note: Fetched. This is Hòa Bình commune, Cà Mau, NOT Trần Đề: do not use for Trần Đề. Seed 80 kg/ha, yield 7.7 t/ha.

areas.summary_en: Nhân Dân describes Mỹ Xuyên (old Sóc Trăng, now Cần Thơ) with most rice land in Đại Tâm on ST25 and an ST24/ST25 seed lineage; the cooperative named in that fetch is Đại Thanh led by Hứa Thành Nghĩa. The '100 ha certified ST24/ST25 at Nghĩa Thắng' and the 'Hòa Tú, 3 ha ST25 after shrimp' claims were not confirmed on a fetched page.
areas.summary_vi: Nhân Dân mô tả Mỹ Xuyên (Sóc Trăng cũ, nay thuộc Cần Thơ): phần lớn đất lúa Đại Tâm trồng ST25, có dòng giống ST24, ST25. HTX nêu trong bài là Đại Thanh (ông Hứa Thành Nghĩa). Thông tin 100 ha ST24/ST25 xác nhận tại Nghĩa Thắng và nông dân Hòa Tú 3 ha ST25 sau tôm chưa được xác nhận trên trang đã mở.

sources.title: Người nông dân thông thái trên cánh đồng lúa ST25
sources.quote: Nguồn giống ST rất hiếm, vì thế, đất trồng lúa ST cũng được chọn lọc rất kỹ.
sources.note: Fetched (first 100k chars). Names Đại Tâm (nay là phường Mỹ Xuyên, Cần Thơ) as mostly ST25 and HTX Đại Thanh (not Nghĩa Thắng). No Hòa Tú found.

sources.title: Nghĩa Thắng cooperative >100 ha certified ST24, ST25
sources.publisher: Nông nghiệp Việt Nam / Lao Động (via search summaries)
sources.quote: HTX hiện có hơn 100ha chuyên sản xuất giống ST24, ST25 cấp xác nhận.
sources.note: Quote came from a search summary; page not opened by us. URL is a guess of the matching article.

sources.title: Hòa Tú farmer 3 ha ST25 after shrimp
sources.note: Could not be found by search; not confirmed.

areas.summary_en: ST25 in Long Đức commune is confirmed by two fetched articles (Jan 2021 harvest at Hưng Lợi cooperative; Feb 2025 50 ha low-emission pilot, 46 households). The 2024 district report naming ST25, Đài Thơm 8, OM18 was not found; an April 2021 district report (snippet) says late winter-spring 2020-21 sowing was mainly Đài Thơm 8. OM18 for Long Phú unconfirmed.
areas.summary_vi: ST25 tại xã Long Đức được xác nhận bằng hai bài đã mở (thu hoạch 1/2021 HTX Hưng Lợi; mô hình phát thải thấp 50 ha, 46 hộ, 2/2025). Báo cáo huyện 2024 nêu ST25, Đài Thơm 8, OM18 không tìm thấy; OM18 ở Long Phú chưa xác nhận.

sources.title: Lúa chất lượng cao, phát thải thấp: Đáp ứng yêu cầu tăng trưởng xanh
sources.quote: ST25, giống lúa đặc sản, chất lượng cao của địa phương, được chọn thí điểm.
sources.note: Fetched. 50 ha, 46 households, Hưng Lợi cooperative, An Hưng hamlet, Long Đức commune. Search snippet adds seed 60 kg/ha (not fetched).

sources.title: Bộ trưởng Nguyễn Xuân Cường thăm đồng lúa ST25 tại Sóc Trăng
sources.quote: ông Long ước năng suất lúa tươi đạt khoảng 6,8-7 tấn/ha
sources.note: Fetched. Long Đức, Hưng Lợi coop over 600 ha, early winter-spring 2020-21.

areas.summary_en: Nga Nam is named only in province-wide programme lists (Mar 2023 VietnamPlus: one of nine speciality-rice localities; Nhân Dân list of districts). The town's 2024 report (ST24, ST25, RVT, Đài Thơm 8, OM18), the summer-autumn 2024 recommendation and the Tân Thành 1.3 ha ST25 harvest were not found.
areas.summary_vi: Ngã Năm chỉ xuất hiện trong danh sách chương trình toàn tỉnh. Báo cáo 2024 của thị xã, khuyến cáo hè thu 2024 và nông dân Tân Thành 1,3 ha ST25 không tìm thấy.

sources.title: Soc Trang increasingly switches to speciality rice varieties
sources.quote: ST24, ST25, Tai Nguyen, RVT and Dai Thom 8
sources.note: Fetched. Province-level share about 92%; lists Nga Nam town among nine localities. No Nga Nam-specific variety.

tolerance.quote: có thể chống chịu mặn cao ở ngưỡng 3-4‰

varieties.notes_vi: Con số lấy từ báo SGGP 12/4/2018, không có bảng khảo nghiệm, không nêu giai đoạn.

tolerance.effect: classed salt-sensitive vs OM 9577 (tolerant) and OC 10 in a proteomic study; NaCl level not given in the abstract

varieties.notes_vi: Chỉ có xếp loại định tính: nhạy mặn (Plant Science Today, 12/2025).

varieties.notes_vi: Không tìm thấy ngưỡng mặn đã công bố.

varieties.name: Rice, general rule (FAO)

tolerance.salt_ppt_or_note: threshold ECe 3.0 dS/m (ECw 2.0); 50% yield at ECe 7.2 dS/m
tolerance.effect: FAO classes paddy rice 'moderately sensitive' (soil salinity, not irrigation water of a given variety)
tolerance.quote: Rice, paddy ... MODERATELY SENSITIVE (Table 5; threshold 3.0 dS/m, Table 4)

tolerance.effect: rice is tolerant at germination per FAO Table 7
FAO flowering statement not confirmed on the fetched page; seedling/flowering sensitivity seen only in search summaries of FAO/IRRI texts

varieties.notes_en: 1 dS/m is about 0.64 g/L (about 0.6 per mille) - conversion is ours, not a source figure.
varieties.notes_vi: Quy đổi 1 dS/m khoảng 0,64 g/L là của chúng tôi.

gaps: Government PDFs on soctrang.gov.vn (Tran De reports) could not be fetched (DNS failure); varieties from them are snippet-only (verified:false).
Vinh Chau: no named-variety source found.
Nga Nam: 2024 town report, summer-autumn 2024 recommendation, Tan Thanh 1.3 ha ST25 harvest not found.
My Xuyen: Nghia Thang 100 ha and Hoa Tu 3 ha ST25-after-shrimp claims not confirmed; fetched Nhan Dan page names Dai Thanh cooperative instead.
Tran De 40 ha ST25 harvest matches a Ca Mau (Hoa Binh) article, not Tran De.
Long Phu: 2024 district report listing OM18 not found.
Several laodong.vn pages returned empty content, so they were not used as verified sources.

No variety-specific, stage-specific salt thresholds found for ST24, ST25, RVT, OM5451; OM18 has only a 3-4 per mille press line. Rice-shrimp rotation use does not establish an irrigation-salinity limit.
Duration, yield and farm-gate price per variety only partial and mostly from unfetched snippets; AGENT NOTE: the 'Hòa Tú' and 'Nghĩa Thắng' URL slots are placeholders or unverified.

feeds.name: NASA POWER daily point API
feeds.update_frequency: daily, lag about 2-3 days (last value 2026-11-11 on 2026-11-14)
feeds.licence: NASA open data, no key; cite NASA POWER
feeds.notes: access-control-allow-origin: * verified. Grid is coarse (about 0.5 deg): Vinh Chau, Tran De and Long Phu return identical values; My Xuyen and Nga Nam identical. -999 = missing. Same source the pipeline already uses, so it is the consistent 'as of' feed.

feeds.name: Open-Meteo forecast API (rain, temperature, 14 days incl. past_days)
feeds.update_frequency: model runs hourly to every few hours
feeds.licence: CC BY 4.0 data; free for non-commercial use without key (fair use, under 10,000 calls/day); attribute Open-Meteo
feeds.notes: access-control-allow-origin: * verified. Licence terms recalled from Open-Meteo's published terms, not re-read today. Only source here with a forecast (next 7 days). Model output, not NASA: label its source.

feeds.name: Open-Meteo historical archive (ERA5 / ERA5-Land based)
feeds.update_frequency: daily; reanalysis normally lags a few days
feeds.licence: as Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0 / non-commercial free tier)
feeds.notes: CORS * verified. It returned a value for 2026-11-14 itself, so recent days are probably filled from a forecast model, not final reanalysis (not verified). Oct 1 to Nov 14 totals (295-327 mm) differ from POWER's Oct 1 to Nov 11 (384-398 mm): the two models disagree by 20-25 percent, so never mix them in one number.

feeds.name: Open-Meteo marine API (sea level incl. tide, wave height)
feeds.update_frequency: model runs, hourly series for next days
feeds.notes: CORS * verified (host is marine-api, NOT marine.open-meteo.com which returned nothing). Gives modelled tide at the sea off Tran De/Vinh Chau (about -0.95 to +2.2 m on 2026-11-14). Useful for 'high tide days = salt pushes up the river' hints; it is a global model, not a gauge, and does not give salinity.

feeds.name: Open-Meteo flood API (GloFAS river discharge)
feeds.notes: CORS * verified, but NOT usable for the Mekong: at the grid cell near Can Tho it returned only 1.5-2.6 m3/s (the Hau River carries thousands), so the 5-km grid misses the main channel and the delta is tidal. Do not show.

feeds.name: NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index text file
feeds.notes: No access-control-allow-origin header, so a browser fetch from github.io is blocked. Fetch it in a scheduled GitHub Action and commit a small JSON.

feeds.name: NOAA CPC ENSO diagnostic discussion (HTML)
feeds.notes: No CORS. Repo's data/raw/enso_outlook.json is stale (issued 2026-10-08, chance >83%); live page now issued 12 Nov 2026.

feeds.name: NASA GIBS WMTS tiles (imagery, e.g. MODIS NDVI, IMERG rain)
feeds.licence: NASA open data, acknowledge NASA GIBS/ESDIS
feeds.notes: CORS * verified on GetCapabilities only; individual tile requests not tested. Good for a live NASA map layer under the pins (Leaflet), not for numbers.

feeds.name: Mekong River Commission portals (monitoring.mrcmekong.org, portal.mrcmekong.org)
feeds.format: Angular single-page apps; no public JSON endpoint found
feeds.notes: Both pages load (HTTP 200) but sent no CORS header, and I did not find a documented open API (api.mrcmekong.org returned 401). No Tan Chau/Chau Doc/My Thuan/Can Tho values were obtained. Do not claim MRC live data.

feeds.name: NCHMF/KTTV 10-day salinity bulletins (PDF)
feeds.update_frequency: every 10 days in dry season (20th, 31st/30th, 10th); season-end bulletin 2026-05-31
feeds.notes: PDFs download (HTTP 200) but no CORS header; folder thuyvan1 vs thuyvan2 varies, so URLs cannot be guessed. Latest found: 2026-05-31 (last of 2025-26 season). No Nov 2026 bulletin published yet; guesses for Oct/Nov dates returned 404. Repo already has 20 bulletins in data/raw/salinity_bulletins.json (read with pdftotext in pipeline).

feeds.name: SIWRR / Vien KHTL mien Nam (siwrr.org.vn)
feeds.notes: Home page loads; no machine-readable salinity feed found. Treat as news source only.

feeds.name: CHIRPS rainfall
feeds.notes: Guessed 2026 directory returned 404 and CORS not confirmed. GeoTIFF is also impractical in-browser. Skipped.

enso.synopsis: strong-to-very-strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027 (greater than 79% chance); Niño-3.4 +2.5 C

rivers.note: No Mekong gauge data obtained. Official flood-peak forecast (Aug 2026): Tan Chau 3.5-3.8 m, Chau Doc 3.1-3.4 m, below average (mae.gov.vn).

bulletins.title: Ba kịch bản nguồn nước ứng phó với El Nino (Southern Institute of Water Resources scenarios, reported by MAE)
bulletins.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Environment (mae.gov.vn), text by Báo Nông nghiệp và Môi trường
bulletins.quote: ranh mặn 4g/l trên các cửa sông Cửu Long dự báo xâm nhập sâu hơn khoảng 10-15km
bulletins.detail: Scenario 2 (inflow 15-20% below normal, like 2015-16): 4 g/l front 15-25 km further, from late December 2026. Scenario 3 like 2019-20 'khả năng không cao'. Flood peak Tan Chau 3.5-3.8 m, Chau Doc 3.1-3.4 m, below average. Sóc Trăng not named. Quote verified in page text via curl; date from the mirror.

bulletins.title: Bộ Nông nghiệp và Môi trường yêu cầu chủ động ứng phó El Nino 2026-2027
bulletins.quote: cao điểm xâm nhập mặn từ tháng 1-4/2027
bulletins.detail: Plan for very-high-risk scenario comparable to 2019-20; high scenario 80,000 ha rice-shrimp, very high 120,000 ha. No Sóc Trăng, no ‰ thresholds.

bulletins.title: Giữ nguồn nước trước El Nino (bài 1): gia tăng sức ép
bulletins.publisher: Báo Nông nghiệp và Môi trường
bulletins.quote: Từ tháng 1/2027, vùng có độ mặn vượt 4 g/l có khả năng xuất hiện
bulletins.detail: Inflow to lower Mekong 10-30% below average; worst intrusion at high tides April-May 2027, 4 g/l front up to 90-125 km on Vam Co, 50-90 km other rivers. Fetched via summariser, quote not re-checked by curl. Sóc Trăng not named.

bulletins.title: Nam Bộ bước vào mùa khô sớm, nguy cơ nắng nóng và thiếu nước gia tăng
bulletins.quote: Đáng lo ngại, mực nước thượng lưu suy giảm kết hợp các kỳ triều cường cao
bulletins.detail: Rainy season may end 15-20 days early; severe 2026-27 dry season expected; no Sóc Trăng and no ‰ values. Fetched via summariser.

bulletins.title: NOAA CPC ENSO Diagnostic Discussion
bulletins.quote: El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027
bulletins.detail: Status El Niño Advisory; chance of strong-to-very-strong greater than 79%; Nino-3.4 +2.5 C. Fetched live by curl today.

bulletins.title: NCHMF salinity bulletin, last of 2025-26 season
bulletins.publisher: Trung tâm Dự báo KTTV quốc gia
bulletins.detail: Only listed by web search as the last 2025-26 bulletin; PDF content not read here (not verified). No Soc Trang station values for Nov 2026 exist yet.

gaps: No MRC station data (Tan Chau, Chau Doc, My Thuan, Can Tho, Vam Nao): MRC portals are JS apps, no CORS, no documented open API found.
No salinity feed usable from a browser: NCHMF PDFs have no CORS and no Nov 2026 bulletin exists yet; salinity stays an estimate from public reports.
No official bulletin names Soc Trang with peak salinity in ‰ for 2026-27; only Delta-wide 4 g/l front scenarios (10-25 km further than 2013-25 average).
A news report of salt arriving early at Vinh Long from mid-November was seen only as a search-result title (tuoitre.vn), not opened: unverified.
Open-Meteo archive for the last days may be forecast-filled; its totals differ 20-25% from NASA POWER.
Open-Meteo flood API unusable for the Mekong (grid misses channel).
CHIRPS endpoint not found; GIBS tile requests (not just capabilities) not tested; Open-Meteo licence text not re-read today.
POWER 'ensemble' for 3 pins identical because grid is coarse.
